headline: Is my soulmate still coming, or have I already missed him?
note: generated from REVIEW-new-voice.md — not a wired draft

a: You turned the Magician. You couldn't see the faces, and your hand found the one who came ready.
Look at his table. Nothing on it has been cleared away.
You asked if he's still coming, or if you've missed him. What catches me is that the table is still set.
The part that doesn't fit is that nobody has come. And you've put the harder half of that question to me yourself.
Whatever is in the way holds steady, and it doesn't come and go. I don't think this began with you.
Let me look closer at what's holding it…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. Nothing told them apart, and you found the calmest face in the deck.
One rope, one ankle, and he's upside down. His face, though — that's calm.
You asked if he's still coming, or if you've missed him. It's the single rope that holds my eye.
Still, nobody has come. And you've asked me to rule on it.
Something sits between you and the answer, close rather than far back. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what this is…
c: You turned the Fool. Face down, all three, and you took the one standing in full sun.
Look at the sky. It's gold, and there's not one cloud across it.
You asked if he's still coming, or if you've missed him. This card brings me to broad daylight, and a foot already moving.
But nobody has come. And you're the one carrying both halves of that question.
Something turns up at the point where this would come good. I don't think any of it began with you.
Let me look closer at what has hold of this…
